```js
export function avg(xs) {
  let sum = 0
  for (let i = 0; i <= xs.length; i++) sum += xs[i]
  return sum / xs.length
}
```

Extract the price calculation in this function into its own helper. While you're at it, the discount is applied twice for VIP users, just fix that too in the same change.

```js
export function checkout(cart, user) {
  let total = 0
  for (const item of cart.items) total += item.price * item.qty
  if (user.vip) total *= 0.9
  total = total - (user.vip ? total * 0.1 : 0)
  return Math.round(total * 100) / 100
}
```
